notes: Small owner-landlord reaching out to an agent to help rent out a garden apartment in their Park Slope brownstone. A lead to win (owner wants a tenant found), not another broker's RENTAL_LISTING. shouldExtractParty=true. Property address present and gradeable.

input.subject: Need help renting my garden apartment
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

We own a brownstone at 588 3rd St in Park Slope and the garden-level 1BR is opening up Sept 1 - our long-term tenant is moving out. We've never used an agent before and honestly don't want to deal with the screening and showings ourselves this time.

It's a nice space, about 650 sf, private garden access, renovated kitchen. We were thinking around $3,300/mo but would trust your read on the market. Would you be able to list it and find us a good tenant? What do you charge?

Thanks,
Susan
